decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly through the use of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Wild Nacatl. The deck also includes powerful support cards like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to deal direct damage and control the board. The inclusion of cards like Nishoba Brawler and Scion of Draco adds resilience and versatility to the aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong presence on the battlefield early on and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also includes a variety of spells and cards that support the combo strategy, such as Persist and Bitter Reunion. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a game-winning play, while utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six to control the board and ensure consistency. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Invasion of Ergamon and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection for key combo pieces.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through land-based abilities and utilizing the synergy between various cards to create explosive turns. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck is able to generate a large amount of mana and play multiple lands per turn, making it easier to cast powerful spells like Primeval Titan. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Tolaria West to generate additional value and search for key combo pieces.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly amass a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with permission spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while protecting its own threats to achieve victory in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 matchup.

This deck focuses on casting spells with the Cascade mechanic to cheat out powerful creatures and create overwhelming board presence quickly. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into Crashing Footfalls and other impactful spells to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan. With a mix of creatures and spells that can be cast for free, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker by sacrificing smaller tokens or lands. The deck also includes a package of removal spells and counter magic to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces. With cards like Persist and Bitter Reunion to help find key pieces and Wrenn and Six for consistent land drops, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while setting up its powerful combo finish.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently cycle through cards while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Grief and Force of Negation. The deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then use Violent Outburst or Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes some control elements like Brazen Borrower and Subtlety to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The overall goal is to set up a powerful board state and quickly close out the game.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost, efficient threats and disruption spells to pressure the opponent early in the game. By combining aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent with counterspells and removal like Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while preventing them from stabilizing or mounting a defense. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps maintain card advantage and selection, allowing the deck to maintain its tempo and pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach along with various artifact and graveyard synergies to generate a powerful combo win condition. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station are key pieces in the combo, allowing the player to continuously loop through their deck and mill themselves while generating mana. Thassa's Oracle serves as the finisher, allowing the player to win the game by revealing their library after milling themselves out. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo while also providing versatility in disrupting opponent's strategies.

The deck focuses on casting cascade spells to cheat out powerful threats and disruptive spells for free. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of 4/4 tokens. Additionally, the deck utilizes counter magic like Force of Negation and removal spells like Subtlety and Dead / Gone to control the board and protect its threats. With a mix of aggro creatures and cascade spells, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo advantage throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize powerful spell cards such as Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate explosive combos and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing a mix of creatures like Archon of Cruelty and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to control the board while setting up game-winning combos. Leyline Binding and Lightning Bolt provide additional control and removal options, while the mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's diverse color requirements.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling and equipping powerful equipment, particularly Colossus Hammer, on creatures to create a fast and deadly threat. This is achieved through cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid. The addition of cards like Inkmoth Nexus and Shadowspear provide additional utility and evasion for the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a massive, hasty creature equipped with multiple powerful equipments, making it difficult for the opponent to effectively deal with the threats presented.

The focus of this deck is to consistently cycle through cards in order to fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to return all those creatures back onto the battlefield at once. This combo allows for a powerful synergy between cycling creatures and mass reanimation, overwhelming the opponent and potentially winning the game in one explosive turn. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counter spells like Force of Negation, as well as creatures that can disrupt the opponent's strategy such as Grief and Brazen Borrower.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan early with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck aims to maintain aggression with cards like Fury and Terminate to clear the way for its creatures to attack. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to capitalize on opponent's spells and graveyard, allowing for additional value and disruption. The inclusion of Feign Death provides added evasion and flexibility in combat situations.

The key concept of this deck is to have a fast and aggressive playstyle by utilizing low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Mishra's Bauble to apply early pressure on the opponent. This strategy is supported by a mix of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, as well as counter spells like Counterspell to protect your board. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Blood Moon and disruptive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler add another layer of control to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield as soon as possible, utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate additional mana. It also aims to use Urza's Saga to tutor for powerful lands and artifacts, such as Karn, the Great Creator. The deck utilizes lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Cavern of Souls to enhance its abilities and produce threats that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Vesuva to disrupt the opponent's strategy and further establish board control.

The deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade in order to cheat out powerful threats quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilizing cards that have Cascade, such as Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can consistently put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute. The deck aims to flood the board with creatures like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Leyline Binding helps control the opponent's board while Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce provide additional removal and disruption. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to maintain tempo and fuel the combo. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells and creatures, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to support the color requirements of the deck.

This control-elemental deck uses a high mana curve to gradually build up board presence and control the game through a combination of removal spells and powerful elemental creatures. By utilizing a companion card and a mix of control spells, including bounce and removal, along with powerful elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef, the deck aims to establish dominance on the board and dictate the pace of the game. With a blend of card draw, removal, and powerful creatures, this deck seeks to out-value opponents and grind out wins in the late game.

This deck focuses on maximizing the effectiveness of +1/+1 counters by utilizing cards like Hardened Scales and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. It also includes versatile creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Hangarback Walker that can benefit from these counters. The Ozolith allows for easy transfer of counters, while Urza's Saga provides additional utility and card advantage. With a mix of artifact creatures, lands that can produce colored mana, and support cards like Ancient Stirrings and Welding Jar, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a powerful board presence and efficient creature interactions.

This deck revolves around the key strategy of cycling powerful creatures with abilities for free or low cost, then using cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to mass reanimate them from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. The deck features a high number of cycle creatures to consistently cycle through the deck and set up the combo. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo and control the game. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game with overwhelming board presence.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while also applying pressure with efficient and powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Grief, Seasoned Pyromancer, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the goal is to control the board while dealing damage quickly. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt ensures that the opponent's game plan is disrupted, giving the Rakdos Aggro player an advantage in the match. Additionally, cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional value and resilience to the deck's creatures.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Growth Spiral and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, while controlling the game with Counterspells and removal like Lightning Bolt. The goal is to assemble the combo of Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent in a single turn. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition through efficient card draw and mana acceleration.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply pressure and control the board early on using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and filter through its library with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. Blood Moon is included to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while the land base allows for consistent color sources and flexibility in fetching specific lands.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures such as Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board and protect its threats. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and ensuring a consistent flow of threats. The mana base is designed to provide the right colors of mana consistently for the spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with Mishra's Bauble, Consider, and Expressive Iteration to maintain tempo and keep up pressure. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the inclusion of snow-covered lands allows for additional flexibility with cards like Counterspell. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through efficient and aggressive plays.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays, leveraging cheap and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent. It also runs a suite of disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to control the game and protect its threats. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent while maintaining control over the game with its spell suite. The mana base is optimized for casting spells early and often, allowing for flexibility in its plays.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain control of the game by using a mix of counterspells and removal while simultaneously applying pressure with efficient and evasive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to be proactive in disrupting the opponent's game plan while also presenting a fast clock to close out the game. The inclusion of card selection tools like Consider and Mishra's Bauble help ensure consistent draws and enable the deck to adapt to different situations effectively.

This Modern Control - UrzaTron deck aims to control the board and disrupt opponents with a variety of colorless spells and artifacts. Utilizing the Urza Lands to assemble Tron, the deck can quickly ramp into powerful threats like Karn Liberated and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also has access to powerful sideboard options with the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring. By combining control elements with powerful late-game threats and access to a versatile sideboard, this deck can adapt to various matchups and strategies in the Modern format.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) in order to generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes control elements such as Karn Liberated and Oblivion Stone to deal with opposing threats, while using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Ancient Stirrings to help find the pieces needed to assemble the UrzaTron combo. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator provides access to a sideboard Wishboard to further enhance the deck's control and versatility.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It uses various colorless threats like Sundering Titan, Ulamog, and Kozilek to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, along with artifact hate like Engineered Explosives and Relic of Progenitus. It also uses Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with big threats.
